subject: dsa
title: Unique Paths
summary: dp[i][j] counts the distinct paths a right/down-only robot can take to reach cell (i, j). The first row and column have exactly one straight-line path; every other cell sums the path counts from above and from the left.
problem: A robot starts at the top-left of a 3 x 4 grid and moves only right or down. Count the distinct paths to the bottom-right corner. dp[i][j] holds the number of paths into cell (i, j).

steps.caption: Goal: count right/down paths to the bottom-right. Build dp where each cell holds the number of paths into it.
The top row and left column each have one straight-line way to reach them, so fill them all with 1.
Fill row 1: each cell = paths from the left + paths from above. So 1+1=2, 2+1=3, 3+1=4.
The bottom-right cell dp[2][3] = 10, so there are 10 unique paths.
